ITEM 1 | Cubed golden-brown pieces with browned, slightly crisp outer surfaces and pale interior edges, irregular chunky shapes about 2-3 cm across, dry matte surface with some darker caramelized patches, clustered in the upper right area of a large square white plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Fresh red watermelon wedges with bright pink-red flesh, moist and juicy looking, cut into triangular/rectangular chunks about 3-5 cm long and 1.5-2 cm thick, scattered black seeds visible embedded in the flesh, sitting in the lower right of the plate beside the browned cubes | 110
